executive_summary: Gemini has captured 27.7% of the AI chatbot market in 2026, positioning itself as a strong competitor to ChatGPT while leveraging Google’s ecosystem. The brand’s rapid model releases (Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon) and aggressive pricing strategy have accelerated adoption across enterprise and consumer segments. However, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta continue to innovate, threatening Gemini’s market share with lower-cost or open-source alternatives.

news_pulse_7_days.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen Flash Rumor: What Is Confirmed [2026]
news_pulse_7_days.content: Two Gemini 4 models carry official status. Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on September 30, 2026, and Google Cloud lists its model ID as `gemini-4-argon`. Google also announced Gemini 4 Carbon, and the company’s own page for it sits at Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon on blog.google. Those two pages are the anchor points for everything else in this story. Argon has the most developer-relevant detail. The introductory price is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, and cached input tokens cost 95% less than the input-token price. Google Cloud says the introductory pricing applies through November 30, 2026. After that, standard pricing takes over at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens. [...] | Item | Gemini 4 Argon detail | Source | --- | Announcement date | September 30, 2026 | Google announcement | | Model ID | gemini-4-argon | Google Cloud | | Introductory input price | $2 per million tokens | Google announcement | | Introductory output price | $10 per million tokens | Google announcement | | Cached input discount | 95% off the input-token price (about $0.10 per million at the introductory rate, derived) | Google announcement | | Introductory window ends | November 30, 2026 | Google Cloud | | Standard input price | $4 per million tokens | Google Cloud | | Standard output price | $20 per million tokens | Google Cloud | [...] When will Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch? No release date has been reported. Anything beyond that statement would be speculation. What does Gemini 4 Argon cost? The introductory price is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens at 95% off the input price. Google Cloud says the introductory pricing runs through November 30, 2026, then moves to $4 and $20. What is the Gemini 4 Argon model ID? Google Cloud lists it as `gemini-4-argon`. Google announced the model on September 30, 2026. Has Google announced other Gemini 4 models? Yes. Besides Argon, Google has officially announced Gemini 4 Carbon, and its announcement page is on blog.google.
